mapper.insert: INSERT INTO daily_chat_summary_states ( user_id, summary_date, source_version, source_updated_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{summaryDate}, 1, NOW(), NOW(), NOW() ) ON CONFLICT (user_id, summary_date) DO UPDATE SET source_version = daily_chat_summary_states.source_version + 1, source_updated_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW()
